summary: Kuryk is Kazakhstan's deep-water Caspian ferry and RoRo port, ~40 nm south of Aktau and a key Trans-Caspian Middle Corridor gateway. Landside it is remote desert; by water it is a direct coastal run from the Aktau waterfront, making a passenger shuttle the natural way to connect the port to the region's only city.
